# Text
Readable prose in one of the type roles: a heading, title, body copy, label, caption or overline. A plain text element, not interactive, with no box, padding or states.

USE WHEN
· Showing headings, titles, body copy, helper text, captions or overlines outside a control.
· Muting secondary copy next to primary copy (tone muted).
DON'T USE WHEN
· Naming a form control → Label.
· Showing one dashboard number → StatCard.
· Setting a page title at display size (no role for it yet, CAND-070).
· Conveying error, success or warning → Alert (Text has no status tones in v1).
HOW TO USE
· Pick the role with variant; the role sets size, weight and line height.
· Pick the colour with tone: default or muted.
· Set the element with as (p, span, div, h1 to h6) so the heading level fits the page outline, whatever the visual role.
DO
· Keep one idea per element; let text wrap, never fix its height.
DON'T
· Use a role just to get its size when the content is not that kind of text.
· Use muted for text a user must read to finish a task unless contrast on that surface is confirmed.
RELATED
· Label — names a form control.
· Alert — carries status colour and an icon.

PROPERTIES
• Variant: heading | title | body | body-sm | label | caption | overline — type role (Type/* text style: Nunito Sans, size and weight bound to the type-<role> variables; heading and title scale with the responsive type collection)
• Tone: default | muted — foreground or foreground-muted; both measure at least 4.5:1 on background, surface and surface-raised in light and dark (Warm does not change them). No status tones in v1: subtle, danger, success and info miss 4.5:1 on some surfaces and wait for the colour tokens to be fixed (DISC-108, CAND-071).
• Text: the content (text property)
